caption: The video depicts a white oval plate on a smooth orange-yellow background, holding a shallow pool of pale yellow liquid on the left and reddish-orange liquid on the right. A thin wooden stick lies diagonally across the pool, with a rounded yellowish gel-like dollop sitting on its middle. Throughout, the dollop steadily loses height and flattens into the surrounding liquid. Its edges blur and merge with the pool, exposing more of the stick’s shaft leading to its right-hand tip. The two-tone liquid remains present with only subtle shifts in the orange-red tint, while the plate, stick position, and background stay essentially fixed. The camera appears static, the dissolving dollop staying near the middle of the plate as the gradual change continues.
relations: The gel dollop on the stick steadily flattens and merges into the surrounding liquid pool.
As the dollop recedes, more of the stick shaft toward its right tip becomes exposed.
The plate, stick position, and orange-yellow background remain essentially fixed throughout.
The two-tone liquid persists with only subtle shifts in the orange-red tint.
